findings.note: fulfill reuses a pre-existing <order>-report.md without binding it to the order's repo (no fetch, no repo comparison; only label-format parse). A stale/planted file becomes 'delivery-ready evidence'. Fix: verify report against fresh fetch or require explicit --reuse with recorded justification. DELIVERY_READY dedupe also silently ignores differing evidence on second call.

_load silently rewrites the projection on ANY head mismatch, including projection-ahead-of-log (truncation/tamper). Only log-ahead (crash between receipt+projection) is legitimate repair; projection-ahead is never legitimate and must raise instead of destroying the tamper evidence.
No inter-process lock: _commit is read-modify-write full-file replace. Two concurrent CLI runs can silently drop receipts (last-writer-wins). Add a lock file (O_EXCL/flock/msvcrt) around load+commit.

fulfill on a zip-upload (or non-owner/repo URL) order crashes with raw ValueError in _github_spec AFTER moving to RUNNING. Fail cleanly with OrderError before the transition; zip path needs a defined fulfill story (manual deliver --report).
